scope: Local ChatGPT/Codex desktop log shapes; no claim of cloud execution coverage
method: Read at most the last 1 MiB of each of six recent files; retain only recognized event names, component names, field presence and counts

interpretation.transport_closed: All 30 sampled records used warning level; closure alone does not prove failure or an interrupted chat
interpretation.response_routed: durationMs, errorCode, method and requestId present; duration scope unverified; do not equate routing with tool or model execution
interpretation.identity: Cross-source chat/request identity equivalence unverified; do not correlate by timing
interpretation.runtime: Startup/ready names observed; no verified attempt pairing
interpretation.version: Audit describes this local installation, not a version-independent logging API

privacy: No raw log records, field values, private paths, chat IDs, URLs, arguments or outputs retained
